items.title: Amazon and University of Michigan give robots a sense of touch
items.summary: From warehouse automation to surgical assistance, many real-world applications depend on robots performing delicate, contact-intensive tasks. Often missing in these situations is the sense of touch: robots need to feel the forces on their fingertips to manipulate objects effectively.
